Wild Route / Yilan Coast · Stage 4

Skip the highway.Ride the coast.

Take the train past the narrowest Suhua tunnels, soak in a carbonated cold spring, then follow a traffic-free bikeway toward Turtle Island’s Milky Sea.

Explore the route ↘
Hualien → Suao → Nanfang’ao → Wushi Harbor → Turtle Island
Now ridingSalt air & open roads
Duration2 Days / 1 Night
TransportBike + TRA TrainRoad / touring bicycle
Distance~35 km totalDay 1: 10–15 km · Day 2: 20–25 km
Difficulty★★☆☆☆Flat, mostly dedicated bike paths, relaxed pace

Highlights: Suao Cold Spring, Nanfang’ao Bridge, Neipi Lover’s Bay, Yilan Coastal Bikeway, Wushi Harbor, Turtle Island Milky Sea.

A two-day field note

Harbors in the morning.An island by afternoon.

A compact stage for riders who want recovery, flat roads and ocean views, with a safe rail transfer in place of the Suhua Highway.

DAY 01
Day one / The arrival
Hualien → Suao Station → Suao Cold Spring → Nanfang’ao → Tofu Cape

Rail Arrival & Harbor Relaxation

Distance10–15 km
TerrainFlat harbor
Highlights

Safe rail transfer, cold spring muscle recovery, then a slow coastal ride on flat harbor roads and beach paths, focused on leg recovery after the previous long-distance rides.

Coastal Bikeway & Island Exploration

Good for a rest stop

Seafood by the harbor

Sample local seafood snacks around Nanfang’ao and Suao, and enjoy a fresh seafood lunch beside Wushi Harbor on day two.

Hour by hour

Plan the day.Pace the ride.

Times are a relaxed guide. Reassemble your bike at Suao Station before you roll out, and keep an eye on the ferry slot on day two.

Day 1 · Rail & Harbor

Hualien to Suao and Nanfang’ao

10:00 – 11:30

Safe Rail Transfer via TRA

Route note: Board the Bike & Rail train from Hualien to Suao Station, bypassing the narrow tunnels and heavy truck traffic of the Suhua Highway.

Prep: Reassemble and inspect your bike (brakes, chain, tire pressure) at the station plaza.

11:30 – 14:00

Suao Cold Spring Park

Experience: Soak in a rare high-concentration carbonated cold spring, a refreshing 22°C all year.

Cyclist benefit: Immersion quickly soothes tired legs.

14:30 – 17:30

Nanfang’ao Harbor & Coast Ride

A flat 3–5 km ride into the heart of Nanfang’ao Fishing Port.

  • Nanfang’ao Bridge: panoramic views of the fishing fleet.
  • Neipi Lover’s Bay: a crescent-shaped ocean bay.
  • Tofu Cape: coastal rock formations and seafood snacks.
18:00

Evening Stay & Recovery

Check into a bicycle-friendly hotel or B&B in Suao or Luodong with indoor bike storage.

Day 2 · Bikeway & Island

Yilan Coastal Bikeway to Turtle Island

08:30 – 11:30

Yilan Coastal Bikeway

Route: Ride north along the dedicated coastal path toward Wushi Harbor, or take a short local train to Toucheng first.

Environment: Green windbreaks on your left, the open Pacific on your right, with Turtle Island always in view.

11:30 – 12:30

Wushi Harbor & Bike Storage

Facilities: Lock your bike at the Wushi Harbor Visitor Center storage area.

Lunch: Fresh seafood by the harbor, with the Lanyang Museum’s single-stone design in view.

13:00 – 16:30

Turtle Island Tour & Milky Sea

Island tour: Pre-booked 30-minute ferry to volcanic landscape, historical tunnels and a freshwater lake.

Milky Sea: Turquoise water fed by submarine thermal springs, with chances of spotting dolphins.

16:30 – 17:30

Northbound Connection

Retrieve your bike and continue north on Provincial Highway 2 toward the Old Caoling Tunnel and Jiufen.

Cyclist & transit tips

Book early.Ride easy.

01 / RAIL

Rail Transfer

Taking the TRA between Hualien and Suao is strongly advised to avoid hazardous mountain highway tunnels.

02 / STORAGE

Bike Storage

Secure bike parking is available at Suao Station and the Wushi Harbor Visitor Center.

03 / PERMITS

Island Permits

Turtle Island landing permits and Milky Sea boat tours fill up fast. Book at least 20 days in advance.
